C.definition: CC-DERIVED (the prompt gives none): every one of the five major routes yields a chain of major-class edges, and every Wookieepedia stop plotted on the DK map is on that chain

continuity_rule.rule: a path may not cross more than 3 px of contiguous background (not lane, not occluded) beyond the two measured rims; occluded pixels are not background and end a run

sensitivity.rule: path may not cross more than N px of contiguous background (decision N = 3); null = rule off

continuity_rule.kink_diagnostic: smoothed-path heading change over 12 px outside the rim zones; stored per edge as kink_deg, never a decision (flag > 40 deg)
